digestFormat: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines: <file SHA-256><two spaces><POSIX path><LF>, sorted by path; three files (descriptor, USDZ, board.json) per committed-asset package and two (descriptor, FCStd source) per source-backed package, whose board.json is generated from the source at build time

boardManifestNote: 2026-09-24: each migrated source now embeds its board.json (minus id) as the document-level HangTenBoardManifest property; only Document.xml changed in each FCStd. board.json is regenerated from it in canonical layout (token-identical to the hand-authored file: same values, key order, and number spellings; only whitespace and string escaping changed, for captain-fingerfood-pocket and both lattice-mxedge-lift packages). lattice-mxedge-lift-small's previous sourceSHA256 (df02a018...) was already stale against the committed source before this change.
buildTimeBoardJSONNote: 2026-09-24: CAD-backed board.json is no longer committed; it is generated from the locked FCStd at build time (package validation, iOS and Android staging). sha256Manifest now covers descriptor + FCStd for the five source-backed packages instead of descriptor + board.json + FCStd; the previous manifest 4af6ea74... moved to supersededSha256Manifest (which previously held abfe9228...). The generated board.json bytes are identical to the last committed ones.
compactIIMigrationNote: 2026-09-24: metolius-wood-grips-compact-ii became the sixth source-backed package. Its FCStd embeds the previously hand-authored board.json as HangTenBoardManifest (set_board_manifest.py; only Document.xml changed; the regenerated board.json is byte-identical to the deleted file), so its lock entry covers descriptor + FCStd. sha256Manifest ff7f8f00... supersedes main's 685f63d9..., which moved to supersededSha256Manifest (which previously held 4af6ea74...).
inventoryNote: main's lock listed 40 model-media packages while the merged tree contains 46, because PR #452 migrated six further boards without refreshing it. The lock now covers all 46. Tools/HangboardModels/tests/test_model_delivery_alignment.py is not executed by CI: the pytest job's working-directory is Tools/HangboardPackages.
deluxeIIMigrationNote: 2026-09-24: metolius-wood-grips-deluxe-ii became a source-backed package authored as native vector geometry, and metolius-rock-rings-3d was recompiled after the curved-face partition change. sha256Manifest 7b9889b9... supersedes ff7f8f00..., which moved to supersededSha256Manifest (which previously held 685f63d9...).
